data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net outstanding claims of USD 1,400.1m (2020: USD 774.1m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior years of account of USD 397.3m (2020: decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2019 and prior years of account USD 145.2m).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 was USD 1,173.605m. During 2021 the Syndicate recorded a net decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior years of account of USD 397.3m (a release), however a gross prior-year movement on a GROSS basis is not explicitly presented. The year is distorted by a significant RITC into the 2019 year (large gross addition to reserves), and the reported USD 397.3m figure is presented on a net basis in the technical reserves note. Consequently the apparent prior year release is recorded here as a net release of USD 397.3m (33.86% of opening gross reserves) with moderate confidence.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net outstanding claims of USD 1,400.1m (2020: USD 774.1m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior years of account of USD 397.3m (2020: decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2019 and prior years of account USD 145.2m).
Net reserves for losses and loss expenses related to the COVID-19 pandemic represents the Syndicate's best estimate of losses and loss expenses that have been incurred at 31 December 2021.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (gross PYD) is not explicitly stated in the report. The report discloses a net decrease in outstanding claims of USD 397.3m relating to 2020 and prior years (used here as a fallback). A large Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) into the 2019 year (gross effect shown in the technical provisions) materially distorts comparisons and makes extraction of a clean gross PYD unreliable from the triangle. Therefore the prior year movement provided is the reported NET decrease; no explicit GROSS prior-year movement was found.
